items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: I remember seeing, uh, uh, an acrobat by the name of a Frenchman. Baptiste Pignot.

ctx.x: And that's where, that's where the, uh, the opera was. You see? And when they built this new opera, uh, I don't know what took place, but it burnt down. And when it burnt down, it remained a lot there. And, uh, I remember I was a little child. I remember seeing, uh, uh, an acrobat by the name of a Frenchman. Baptiste Pignot. He died from that, from a tower they had there and broke his neck. I witnessed that because my father held me on his shoulder. I must have been a little child then about three, four years…
That's the devil. That's the devil.
